subject: A professional way to share codes and results of R with a colleague

messages.author: 355628393e8b857f
messages.subject: A professional way to share codes and results of R with a colleague
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I had a very general question to ask. It's been a while that I have started research and I am new to R. Which way to do you propose as both an optimum and professional way to share codes and results of R with a colleague in academia? 

I see developers using GitHub, I am not sure if it is so popular in academia as well and if it has the ability to share the results in tandem with codes? 

I also see some researchers in specific countries use OSF and still have no clue if they can share the results and whether it is popular on an international level or not!  

Looking forward to your insights,
Thanks for your time, 
Sara

messages.author: 17944621d521fdfa
messages.subject: Re: A professional way to share codes and results of R with a colleague
parts:
I would say OSF or OSF and version control system if you plan to update your script. 
https://help.osf.io/hc/en-us/articles/360019971574-Version-Control

messages.author: bc2ebdf9c891d654
messages.subject: Re: A professional way to share codes and results of R with a colleague
parts: Hi, Rmarkdown and especially Rnotebook work well for me. I can write the paper, put the Rcode in the text, runit and have the output incorporated, and then save as word doc. It is completely transparent what has been done and others can see clearly. Then for actual journal output you can drop the R code, etc. Haerold

messages.subject: Re: A professional way to share codes and results of R with a colleague
parts: Hi, R notebook has been really nice for me. Previously would do stats in R, save, work on the paper in Word or whatever, then go back, etc. Eventually I would get lost on what I had done.  Sharing with others is just another level of complication. In markdown I can keep it completely transparent for me or others. May just be my cognitive limitations but I may not be the only one! best harold
